title: How to recruit and activate high-quality affiliates: Dustin Howes's 5-step playbook
summary: A Rewardful webinar recap where Dustin Howes lays out a five-step system for affiliate programs: define ideal partner personas, recruit outbound, personalize outreach, vet applicants, then onboard so partners earn their first commission fast. Recruitment is treated as ongoing pipeline work, not a one-time task.

principles.text: Recruitment and activation are the engine of an affiliate program, not an afterthought.
principles.quote: Too many brands expect affiliates to just show up, grab a link, and go. Recruitment and activation end up last on the task list—yet they’re the engine of the program.

principles.text: Know your ideal customer before defining your ideal affiliate; write partner personas before pitching.
Optimize for revenue concentration, not affiliate count; a few partners drive most sales.
principles.quote: Vanity metrics (total affiliates) don’t matter, revenue concentration is real.

principles.text: Fund an exploratory budget (fee, free product, commission) to lift response rates from competitive partners.
principles.quote: Exploratory budget (even modest) dramatically lifts response rates.

principles.text: Skip mass blasts; send targeted, human outreach that shows you looked and offers value.
principles.quote: Skip the mass blast. Aim for targeted, human messages.

principles.text: Treat affiliate activation like product onboarding, aiming at the first commission.
principles.quote: Treat affiliate activation like product onboarding: the “aha” moment is their first commission.
